findings.issue: Cited n0334 (Reuters, 'Rheinmetall Q3 profits jump on strong ammunition sales', stamped 2023-10-25 07:00 placeholder) as a completed Q3 result. Rheinmetall's scheduled Q3 statement normally falls in November, so this completed-result record is plausibly misdated and published after the cutoff.
findings.resolution: Removed the Rheinmetall Q3-profit claim and n0334; replaced with Reuters n0316 (military equipment for Ukraine helps fuel General Dynamics' profit, 2023-10-25) and kept only the card move for Rheinmetall (+14.00% over 20 sessions to 270.40 EUR).

findings.issue: 'McDonald's beat on higher prices' had no supporting headline in the paragraph; n1256 supports only the loss of low-income customers.
findings.resolution: Added Investopedia n0776 ('McDonald's Beats Profit and Sales Forecasts on Higher Prices, Larger Average Tickets', 2023-10-30) and reworded to 'McDonald's beat forecasts on higher prices'.

findings.issue: 'so for dollar-based holders the ETF route delivered the larger gain' compared EPOL (MSCI Poland, USD) with the WIG20TR tracker (PLN): both are ETFs, the indexes differ, and the implied currency effect has no headline support.
findings.resolution: Deleted the inference; sentence now states EPOL gained 20.38% over its own 20 sessions.

findings.resolution: Changed to 'at APEC in November', which is what n0120's 'next month' meant on its publication date.

findings.issue: Same 'next month' problem with the Guardian n0137 (2023-10-31). Also 'The SCMP quoted an expert': n0142's headline is an unattributed quotation, so the speaker's role is not established.
findings.resolution: Changed to 'in November'. Reworded to 'The SCMP carried the view that differing US and Chinese objectives will limit the outcomes'.
